map.：矩阵 [[a,b],[c,d]] 的行列式 = ad-bc。例 [[3,1],: : the determinant of the matrix [[a,b],[c,d]] is ad-bc. For [[3,1],[2,4]] the determinant = 3×4−1×2=10≠0, so the matrix is invertible and the system has a unique solution.
map.：二阶行列式的绝对值等于两列向量张成的平行四边形面积；为 0 表示两向量共线（变: : the absolute value of a 2x2 determinant equals the area of the parallelogram spanned by the two column vectors; a value of 0 means the vectors are collinear (the transform squashes the plane into a line).
map.行列式为 0 说明什么？: What does a zero determinant mean?
map.矩阵不可逆（奇异），列向量线性相关，对应线性方程组要么无解要么无穷多解，线性变换: A singular (non-invertible) matrix has linearly dependent column vectors; the corresponding linear system has either no solution or infinitely many solutions — the linear transform reduces dimension.
map.主对角线乘积减副对角线乘积：ad-bc。高阶用按行/列展开或化简，但二阶就这一条: Product of the main diagonal minus the product of the anti-diagonal: ad-bc. Higher orders use row/column expansion or simplification, but for 2x2 this is the only rule.
